name: Signed scalar / component volume
description: Volume rendering of one explicitly named point field and zero-based component, preserving signed values. Optional result-unit metadata relabeling does not convert values.

bindings.name: data
bindings.description: The directory (or Runtime task) holding the field file.

graph.name: Signed scalar / component volume
graph.description: stk.filter.calculator (component, no magnitude) -> stk.render.volume. Input must be a numeric non-label point field of an image.

parameters.name: path
parameters.label: Field file
parameters.description: Path inside the binding: DAT, NPY, VTI, legacy VTK or VTKHDF.

parameters.name: field
parameters.label: Field name
parameters.description: Exact STK point-field name. Missing, nonnumeric and label fields are errors; there is no automatic fallback.

parameters.name: component
parameters.label: Component (0-based)
parameters.description: Zero for scalar data; a vector or array component must exist. Never computes a magnitude.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.label: Result unit (label only)
parameters.description: Null preserves the source unit. A nonempty string only relabels the selected field; it does not convert numerical values.

parameters.name: range
parameters.label: Value range
parameters.description: [min, max] of the transfer functions (null = the data range).

parameters.name: opacity
parameters.label: Opacity points
parameters.description: [x, alpha] pairs, x normalized over the value range.
